name: Incapacitated
description: You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction; your Concentration is broken; you can't speak; you have Disadvantage on Initiative rolls.

name: Paralyzed
description: You have the Incapacitated condition; your Speed is 0; you automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saves; attack rolls against you have Advantage; any attack that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet.

name: Unconscious
description: You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions and drop whatever you're holding; your Speed is 0; you automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saves; attack rolls against you have Advantage; any attack that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet; you are unaware of your surroundings.
